description: Fetches one public page the way a search engine does and checks the title, meta description, canonical, noindex and robots.txt, H1 headings, word count, image alt text and structured data. Returns what it found and a list of problems in order of importance. Works without any Google credentials. Read-only: it only downloads the page.

url.description: Full URL of any public page to check, including https://.

name: page_check
title: Check one page
